name: runpool
title: RunPool
description: Manage on-demand self-hosted GitHub Actions runner pools on your Mac
author: aic

commands.name: pools
commands.title: Show Runner Pools
commands.subtitle: RunPool
commands.description: See every runner pool, start and stop them, and change how many runners each has

commands.name: recent-runs
commands.title: Show Recent Workflow Runs
commands.subtitle: RunPool
commands.description: See recent GitHub Actions workflow runs for repositories served by your runner pools

commands.name: manage-runner-pools
commands.title: Manage Runner Pools
commands.subtitle: RunPool
commands.description: Pause or resume automatic runner pools without affecting other CI providers

commands.name: status
commands.title: Runner Status
commands.subtitle: RunPool
commands.description: Keep a live summary of the pools in this command's subtitle

commands.name: menubar
commands.title: Runner Status in Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: RunPool
commands.description: Show how much of your runner capacity is busy, as a fill level in the menu bar

preferences.name: colourIcon
preferences.title: Appearance
preferences.label: Use the RunPool blue
preferences.description: Off by default, so the icon matches the other items in your menu bar.

preferences.name: runpoolPath
preferences.title: Executable Path
preferences.description: Only if runpool is installed somewhere unusual.

tools.name: get-status
tools.title: Get Pool Status
tools.description: Read every runner pool: how many runners each has, how many are running, how many jobs are in flight, and what GitHub sees

tools.name: start-pool
tools.title: Start Pool
tools.description: Bring a pool's runners online immediately, rather than waiting for a queued job to wake it

tools.name: stop-pool
tools.title: Stop Pool
tools.description: Stand a pool's runners down. Refuses while a job is running, because stopping mid-job fails it

tools.name: set-pool-count
tools.title: Set Runner Count
tools.description: Change how many runners a pool has. Growing registers new runners with GitHub, shrinking deregisters them

tools.name: toggle-pause
tools.title: Pause or Resume Runner Pools
tools.description: Pause stands every RunPool runner down and stops pools waking. Resume returns them to on-demand

tools.name: pause-pool
tools.title: Pause Pool
tools.description: Persistently pause one pool. It stops its runners and will not wake until resumed

tools.name: resume-pool
tools.title: Resume Pool
tools.description: Resume one persistently paused pool so it can wake for queued work

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
